page.text:
This categoricity is the reason one may move between abstract natural
numbers and von Neumann ordinals without changing arithmetic. The
underlying sets are different descriptions; the successor structures are
isomorphic. Properties expressible solely in terms of zero, successor,
and definitions derived from them are transported along the unique
isomorphism.
